title: Neon Goals
subtitle: AI Goal Management
description:
Neon Goals turns broad ambitions into focused goals, projects, and next actions through a neon-styled planning workspace. The app combines daily commitments, category views, deadlines, wishlist and research tracking, and an AI planning assistant in one responsive interface.

The system includes a React and TypeScript client, a NestJS service, PostgreSQL persistence, OAuth authentication, and a user-scoped MCP endpoint so trusted assistants can read goals and perform idempotent goal and task updates. A public demo mode makes the full product experience explorable without touching real user data.
